title: [WIP] Complete all development as per roadmap
body:
- [x] **N.1 v3.0.0 Deep Integration (P0)** — All 8 items complete
  - [x] N.1.1: Adopt Cloud namespace — `CloudOperations` class (deploy, hosting, marketplace)
  - [x] N.1.2: Integrate contracts module — `validatePluginContract`, `generateContractManifest`
  - [x] N.1.3: Integrate integration module — `IntegrationManager` (Slack, email, webhook connectors)
  - [x] N.1.4: Integrate security module — `SecurityManager` (CSP, audit logging, data masking)
  - [x] N.1.5: Adopt studio module — canvas config, grid snapping, auto-layout algorithms
  - [x] N.1.6: PaginatedResult migration verified (records/total/hasMore)
  - [x] N.1.7: ObjectStackAdapter `getItems`/`getCached` + `MetadataCache.getCachedSync`
  - [x] N.1.8: 17 v3.0.0 compatibility tests — all passing
- [x] **N.2 Designer Completion — Phase 2: Interaction Layer (P0)** — All 5 items complete
  - [x] N.2.1: Drag-and-drop via native HTML5 DnD in all 5 designers
  - [x] N.2.2: Undo/redo via `useUndoRedo` hook (command pattern) in all designers
  - [x] N.2.3: Confirmation dialogs via `useConfirmDialog` + `ConfirmDialog` component
  - [x] N.2.4: Edge creation UI in ProcessDesigner (click-to-connect with connection ports)
  - [x] N.2.5: Inline entity field editing in DataModelDesigner
- [x] **N.2 Designer Completion — Phase 3: Advanced Features (P0)** — All 7 items complete
  - [x] N.2.6: `PropertyEditor` component with grouped fields and live preview
  - [x] N.2.7: i18n integration — all hardcoded strings in LABELS constants
  - [x] N.2.8: Canvas pan/zoom via `useCanvasPanZoom` + `Minimap` component
  - [x] N.2.9: Auto-layout algorithms (grid-based for DataModel, topological for Process)
  - [x] N.2.10: Copy/paste via `useClipboard` hook (Ctrl+C/V)
  - [x] N.2.11: Multi-select via `useMultiSelect` hook (Shift+Click)
  - [x] N.2.12: Responsive/collapsible panel layout with toggle buttons
- [x] **N.2 Designer Completion — Phase 4: Collaboration Integration (P0)** — All 5 items complete
  - [x] N.2.13: `useCollaboration` wired into all 5 designers
  - [x] N.2.14: Live cursor positions via collaboration context
  - [x] N.2.15: Operation-based undo/redo synchronized via `sendOperation`
  - [x] N.2.16: Conflict resolution UI via collaboration provider
  - [x] N.2.17: `VersionHistory` component with timeline and restore
- [x] ROADMAP.md updated to mark all N.1 and N.2 items as complete
- [x] Plugin-designer index.tsx updated to export new hooks and components
- [x] Tests validated — 17/17 v3.0.0 compatibility tests passing
- [ ] N.3-N.5, Q4 items are business/infra (marketplace website, Discord, YouTube, Cloud hosting, industry solutions, partnerships) — not implementable as code
